title.value: IGLUE: A Benchmark for Transfer Learning across Modalities, Tasks, and Languages
title.justification: The title was chosen as it is the exact title of the paper and encapsulates the main focus of the paper which is introducing the IGLUE benchmark for multilingual and multimodal transfer learning.
title.quote: IGLUE: A Benchmark for Transfer Learning across Modalities, Tasks, and Languages

extractions.description: The paper introduces IGLUE, a multilingual and multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate cross-lingual transfer in vision-and-language (V&L) tasks across 20 different languages. The benchmark includes tasks like visual question answering, cross-modal retrieval, grounded reasoning, and grounded entailment. It provides comprehensive datasets and standard evaluation protocols for zero-shot and few-shot learning scenarios, highlighting existing challenges and performance gaps in current multilingual multimodal models.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not focus on environmental issues or applications directly related to eco-responsible AI. It centers around a multilingual and multimodal benchmark for vision-and-language tasks.
primary_category.quote: Reliable evaluation benchmarks designed for replicability and comprehensiveness have driven progress in machine learning. Due to the lack of a multilingual benchmark, however, vision-and-language research has mostly focused on English language tasks.
